body: RHOANNA, the Hippus Queen who united the warring horse tribes, leader of the Hippus in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; female; in her late twenties; tall and straight-backed, a born rider, one shoulder held a little stiff and low from an old wound. Sun-browned, wind-weathered skin, a strong jaw, a long thick chestnut braid, clear green eyes under straight dark brows.
costume: her family's imposing heirloom armour of burnished bronze plates, a little too broad for her, over a burnt-orange quilted gambeson, a rust-brown cloak at her back and a curved horseman's sword at her hip.
signature: Whatever else she wears, one broad BRONZE PAULDRON from her family's heirloom armour, a size too big and burnished bright, is strapped over her stiff shoulder.

vibes.name: Feud Breaker
vibes.line: Leaning across the council fire, her right hand pouring mare's milk from a flask into one bowl held in her left, for two scowling chiefs in shadow to share; one brow raised, a sly half-smile, eyes sideways on the elder; a felt council tent at night, firelight from below.
vibes.wears: a chieftain's long wine-red felt coat embroidered at the hems with galloping gold horses, a cream silk shirt, a heavy belt of silver plaques, red cord wound through her braid.

vibes.name: Bronze Heirloom
vibes.line: Her right hand buckling her father's too-broad bronze pauldron over her stiff shoulder, her left holding his crested helmet against her hip; chin up, lips pressed tight, eyes straight at the viewer; his grave cairn on a windy hill, cold pink dawn glinting on the bronze.
vibes.wears: her family's whole heirloom armour of burnished bronze scale plates, too broad in the shoulders for her, over a burnt-orange quilted gambeson, a rust-brown cloak and a curved horseman's sword.

vibes.name: United Tribes
vibes.line: Alone before a hundred horsetail standards, both hands knotting one more tribe's coloured ribbon onto the standard pole held in the crook of her arm, already thick with ribbons; a small closed-mouth smile, chin raised, eyes past the viewer on the horizon; open steppe at golden sunset, long shadows.
vibes.wears: a riding coat sewn from the felts of many tribes, each panel a different tribe's colour of red, ochre, blue or green, over a dark leather jerkin, horsehair tassels at the shoulders.

vibes.name: Peace Rider
vibes.line: Riding alone between two lined-up hordes, her left hand holding the reins short, her right holding her sheathed sword up crosswise, its hilt bound to the scabbard with white cord; eyes level on the far line of riders, mouth set; a wide grass valley at flat overcast noon, dust hanging.
vibes.wears: a long undyed white felt coat, the colour of parley among the tribes, a sky-blue sash, no other armour, a white ribbon tied at the end of her braid.
